scene_label: 2D (inputs.json); the render is a perspective street view, but both movers travel parallel to the image plane along one cross street at nearly the same depth
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin at top-left of the image) and seconds; t = frame/24

camera.motion: static: phase correlation on a static region, max |shift| < 0.08 px over all 80 frames

perspective.cross_street: runs horizontally across the image between y~700 (far edge/stop line) and y~752 (near white line, x 1050-1500); both movers ride along it left to right
perspective.relative_depth_note: rows below horizon: van 145, cyclist 140 -> cyclist about 3-4 % farther from the camera than the van (small; a single px scale is the 2D convention)

camera.apparent_size_change: none: rigid template matches with no scale change; side-view length of the van and cyclist constant within +-2 px whenever unoccluded (van appears longer when left of centre because its front face becomes visible, see notes)

van.description: white police van (Belgian-style blue chevron stripes, 'Police' on side, blue flashing light bar on roof, blue flashing lights in front grille); drives left to right along the cross street, the larger of the two movers, behind the cyclist
van.reference_point: centre of the rigid side-view body box (ref_x, ref_y); also mid-axle ground point (midaxle_ground_x, ground_y=743)
van.pixel_motion: uniform horizontal, +27.00 px/frame (std 0.15) over frames 21-79, no vertical motion (dy = 0)

cyclist.description: person on a bicycle (light blue/grey helmet with orange light, green backpack, dark top, orange shorts, yellow basket on handlebar, white/pink bike); rides left to right ahead of the van
cyclist.reference_point: centre of the rigid side-view box of person+bike (ref_x, ref_y); pelvis is near (ref_x - 10, 660) - the saddle/hip sits about 10 px behind the box centre
cyclist.pixel_motion: uniform horizontal, +21.03 px/frame (std 0.35) over frames 0-79, no vertical motion

events.event: cyclist already moving, front half entering at left image edge
van front appears at left image edge (already moving at full speed)
van rear inside the frame (whole van visible, lower part behind left fence)
van front (template box) 4.6 px behind cyclist rear wheel
van front and cyclist rear wheel overlap in the image (-1.3 px); cyclist is ~5 px higher (farther) so this is image overlap, not confirmed contact
video ends; both still moving at constant pixel speed, neither stops, turns or leaves the frame

main_street.desc: road running away from camera to the vanishing point (990,598)
main_street.near_width_px: at y=1050 from left kerb x~150 to right kerb x~1900+

main_street_centre_lines.desc: yellow double centre line: solid line + dashed line
main_street_centre_lines.dashes: x 1010-1095, y 760-1080; dash length grows from ~8 px (y 760) to ~20 px (y 1060)

left_lamp_pole.desc: grey vertical lamp pole in front of the cross street, left

pole_x545.desc: dark pole by the corner shop (traffic light/sign pole)

traffic_light_right.desc: black traffic-light pole with red light, right sidewalk

left_foreground_fence.desc: dark spiked metal fence along the left near sidewalk, diagonal
left_foreground_fence.occludes: lower parts of both movers while x < ~600

right_foreground_fence.desc: dark metal fence at right edge
right_foreground_fence.occludes: cyclist front tip at frame 79 only

far_fences.desc: low dark picket fences behind the cross street

corner_shop.desc: corner shop with red window frames and lit interior, left

grey_building_far_left.desc: low grey tiled building, far left

white_houses_right.desc: row of white stone houses with dark roofs, right

bunting.desc: strings of red and white triangular pennants across the street; nearest string spans the image top (y 0-190), others at y~300-480
bunting.note: static (no motion in median background diff)

street_lamps.desc: lamp posts along the main street
